name: Pasifik Teknoloji AS
summary: Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. provides computer hardware, electronic products, and software products to corporate companies in Turkey. It offers cybersecurity and IT/hardware/infrastructure services, as well as offers defense technologies. The company was formerly known as Pasifik Donanim ve Yazilim Bilgi Teknolojileri A.S. and changed its name to Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. in August 2024. Pasifik Teknoloji A.S. was founded in 2015 and is based in Sariyer, Turkey.
